Payroll tax in Ghana is typically calculated at 28% of gross salary. Here's the breakdown:

📊 Tax Calculation:
• Gross Salary: Employee's base monthly pay
• PAYE Tax: 28% of gross salary
• Deductions: Pension (5%), National Insurance (2.75%)
• Net Salary: Gross - Tax - Deductions

Example:
- Gross: GHS 5,000
- Tax (28%): GHS 1,400
- Deductions: GHS 387.50
- Net: GHS 3,212.50
